text: models estimated OLS expanding window p lags variable. origin form one-step-ahead forecast, roll forward one month.
code: make_lags <- function(z, p) {    n <- length(z)   sapply(seq_len(p), function(k) c(rep(NA, k), z[seq_len(n - k)]))  }  recursive_arx <- function(y, x, p, R) {    n <- length(y)   YL <- make_lags(y, p)   XL <- make_lags(x, p)   target <- y[(p + 1):n]   YL <- YL[(p + 1):n, , drop = FALSE]   XL <- XL[(p + 1):n, , drop = FALSE]   P <- length(target) - R      e_ar <- e_arx <- numeric(P)      for (j in seq_len(P)) {      idx     <- seq_len(R + j - 1)     fit_ar  <- lm.fit(cbind(1, YL[idx, ]),         target[idx])     fit_arx <- lm.fit(cbind(1, YL[idx, ], XL[idx, ]), target[idx])     pred_ar  <- sum(coef(fit_ar)  * c(1, YL[R + j, ]))     pred_arx <- sum(coef(fit_arx) * c(1, YL[R + j, ], XL[R + j, ]))     e_ar[j]  <- target[R + j] - pred_ar     e_arx[j] <- target[R + j] - pred_arx    }      list(e_ar = e_ar, e_arx = e_arx)  }

title: Replicating Rossi (2006)
text: Let ete_t denote log exchange rate Δet=et−et−1\Delta e_t = e_t - e_{t-1} monthly return. compare two one-step-ahead forecasts Δet+1\Delta e_{t+1}: Benchmark (driftless random walk): Δêt+1RW=0\widehat{\Delta e}^{RW}_{t+1} = 0. Alternative (AR(pp)): Δêt+1AR=α̂t+∑k=1pβ̂k,tΔet−k+1\widehat{\Delta e}^{AR}_{t+1} = \hat\alpha_t + \sum_{k=1}^{p} \hat\beta_{k,t}\, \Delta e_{t-k+1}, coefficients re-estimated period. Following Rossi, AR(1) AR(2) share usable sample nobs=307n_{obs} = 307 returns. first R=⌈nobs/2⌉=154R = \lceil n_{obs}/2 \rceil = 154 observations fit initial model, remaining P=153P = 153 evaluated sample. Three estimation schemes considered: Split: coefficients estimated 1:R1{:}R held fixed. Recursive: coefficients re-estimated period using available data. Rolling: coefficients re-estimated period using recent RR observations.
code: forecast_oos <- function(log_fx, p, scheme = c("split", "recursive", "rolling")) {    scheme <- match.arg(scheme)    T_full <- length(log_fx)   dy <- diff(log_fx)   Y  <- dy[3:(T_full - 1)]   L1 <- dy[2:(T_full - 2)]   L2 <- dy[1:(T_full - 3)]   Xm <- if (p == 1) matrix(L1, ncol = 1) else cbind(L1, L2)    n_obs <- length(Y)   R     <- as.integer(ceiling(n_obs / 2))   P_oos <- n_obs - R    e_alt   <- numeric(P_oos)   e_bench <- numeric(P_oos)    for (j in seq_len(P_oos)) {      idx <- switch(scheme,       split     = seq_len(R),       recursive = seq_len(R + j - 1),       rolling   = j:(R + j - 1)     )      Z <- cbind(1, Xm[idx, , drop = FALSE])     b <- as.numeric(solve(crossprod(Z), crossprod(Z, Y[idx])))     pred <- as.numeric(c(1, Xm[R + j, ]) %*% b)      e_alt[j]   <- Y[R + j] - pred     e_bench[j] <- Y[R + j]    }    list(e_bench = e_bench, e_alt = e_alt, P = P_oos)  }

code: specs <- list(   list(label = "1892+",  R = 20L),   list(label = "1965+",  R = which(wg$year == 1964)),   list(label = "1976+",  R = which(wg$year == 1975)) )  run_spec <- function(spec) {    fc    <- recursive_forecasts(wg$logeqp, wg$log_dp_lag, R = spec$R)   MSE_N <- mean(fc$e_N ^ 2)   MSE_A <- mean(fc$e_A ^ 2)   T_oos <- length(fc$e_N)   R2    <- 1 - MSE_A / MSE_N   R2bar <- 1 - (1 - R2) * (T_oos - 1) / (T_oos - 2)   dRMSE <- sqrt(MSE_N) - sqrt(MSE_A)   msef  <- mse_f_test(fc$e_N, fc$e_A)   enc   <- enc_new(fc$e_N, fc$e_A)   cw    <- cw_test(fc$e_N, fc$e_A, fc$f_N, fc$f_A)    data.frame(spec      = spec$label,              T_oos     = T_oos,              R2bar_pct = 100 * R2bar,              dRMSE_pct = 100 * dRMSE,              MSE_F     = unname(msef$statistic),              ENC_NEW   = unname(enc$statistic),              CW_stat   = unname(cw$statistic),              CW_p      = unname(cw$pvalue))  }  tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(specs, run_spec)) knitr::kable(   tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,   col.names = c("Spec", "$T$",                 "$\\bar R^2_{OS}$ (%)",                 "$\\Delta\\mathrm{RMSE}$ (%)",                 "MSE-F", "ENC-NEW",                 "CW stat", "CW $p$"))

code: # IS residuals from a single regression on the entire sample fit_full <- lm(logeqp ~ log_dp_lag, data = wg) is_xy    <- residuals(fit_full) is_mean  <- wg$logeqp - mean(wg$logeqp)  # OOS residuals starting at year 21 R <- 20L fc <- recursive_forecasts(wg$logeqp, wg$log_dp_lag, R = R)  is_imp  <- cumsum(is_mean^2) - cumsum(is_xy^2) oos_imp <- c(rep(NA, R), cumsum(fc$e_N^2) - cumsum(fc$e_A^2))  df <- data.frame(year = wg$year, IS = is_imp, OOS = oos_imp) df_long <- rbind(   data.frame(year = df$year, kind = "IS",  value = df$IS),   data.frame(year = df$year, kind = "OOS", value = df$OOS) )  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = year, y = value, color = kind,                     linetype = kind)) +   annotate("rect",            xmin = 1973, xmax = 1975,            ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,            fill = "red", alpha = 0.15) +   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +   scale_color_manual(values = c(IS = "black", OOS = "steelblue4")) +   scale_linetype_manual(values = c(IS = "dashed", OOS = "solid")) +   labs(x = NULL,        y = "Cumulative SSE difference (NULL − ALT)",        title = sprintf("d/p, 1872 - %d", max(wg$year))) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(legend.title = element_blank(),         legend.position = "top")

text: uniform multi-horizon SPA test statistic $$t^{uSPA} = \min_{1 \le h \le H}   \frac{\sqrt{T}\, \bar d_h}{\sqrt{\hat\omega_h}},$$ \(\bar d_h\) sample mean loss differential L_bench - L_comp horizon h, \(\hat\omega_h\) Quadratic-Spectral HAC long-run variance estimate (Andrews, 1991). Critical values obtained moving-block bootstrap recenters loss differentials null imposed (Quaedvlieg, 2021), "natural variance" estimator recomputed within bootstrap replication. resulting p-value upper-tail: large positive values statistic (.e. benchmark higher loss uniformly across horizons) lead rejection. Equivalently, rejection requires \(\bar d_h > 0\) every horizon; test limited power alternatives benchmark worse horizons. port Matlab reference implementation accompanying Quaedvlieg (2021); helpers .mbb_indices, .mbb_variance, .qs_lrvar translate Get_MBB_ID.m, MBB_Variance.m, QS.m respectively.
